origin: Reviewed workspace standards, existing primary-source records, and observed user-authored layout methods
scope: Portable schematic and PCB methods with user defaults; private project circuits, screenshots and source documents are excluded
name: embedded-hardware-design

upstream_skills.integration: Original summary and corrections, no copied upstream sources or example netlists
upstream_skills.verification: Original downloaded bytes checked against Git blobs; installed compatibility moved into metadata for local schema, body unchanged; no live EDA execution

sample_review.verification: Read/export and style review only; no circuit edits, ERC/DRC, SI/PI or measurements
sample_review.redistribution: Original method summaries only; source projects, images, netlists and private identifiers excluded

teardrop_finish_rule.scope: User default sequence, not universal coverage requirement

assembly_decoupling_review.source: User feedback and PCB copper-path/assembly review; geometric evidence does not prove measured performance

pcb_stage_review.source: User feedback about rules not enforced during first layout
pcb_stage_review.scope: Review coverage and evidence freshness gates, not automated electrical validation

sources: Murata ceramic capacitor FAQ char/0005, main text and first DC-bias figure
mlcc_effective_capacitance.scope: No universal package-capacitance ceilings; exact-MPN effective capacitance under actual conditions. No board edits or retroactive component validation.

engineering_workflow.scope: Risk-proportionate requirements/acceptance, interface contracts, calculations, model limits, assembly/test access and prototype feedback. Documentation-only update; no EDA edits or measurements.

visible_usage.source: User request for automatic hardware-task selection and visible usage
visible_usage.scope: Allow implicit invocation; read installed entry/version and applicable references before announcing actual version and scope; report evidence and pending checks. Local user/workspace AGENTS pointers supplement discovery. No claim of guaranteed future invocation or hardware validation.

pcb_power_plane_geometry.scope: Prefer rectangular or simple orthogonal power regions on native inner plane layers; document necessary mechanical splits and verify clearances, minimum copper width, connectivity, return paths, and Gerber. No board-level DRC is implied.

pcb_layer_reference_selection.source: User correction during four-layer PCB design
pcb_layer_reference_selection.scope: Select layer order from the actual differential routing layer and return path. For bottom-layer differential routing, prefer the adjacent inner layer as continuous GND reference and the other inner layer for power; ordinary and slow routing must not disrupt that channel or return. This is a reusable routing preference, not a fixed manufacturer stackup or an impedance guarantee.

pcb_silkscreen_pad_clearance_review.source: User-authored EasyEDA board read read-only; screenshot/native project details are excluded from the portable package
pcb_silkscreen_pad_clearance_review.scope: Arial is a workspace/user default with size and stroke selected for purpose and fabrication. Prefer clearance from holes, mask openings and same-side trace projections for legibility. Keep independent same-net physical pads separated and connect with compliant copper; do not confuse compound lands, GND pours or DRC with assembly verification. Current board was not edited and DRC was not run.

pcb_rule_gate_and_layer_semantics.scope: Require separate workspace rule-gate and current-revision EDA DRC evidence. Permit four SIGNAL layers and SIGNAL-layer power regions when documented as actual copper zones; require PLANE only when native inner-plane semantics are explicitly requested. Do not infer a 90 ohm differential width from a fixed mil value; calculate from the confirmed stackup. Treat locked components, interfaces, board outline and holes as mechanical baselines and compare before/after. No EDA board was modified.
